notes.title: KONOSUBA! Welcomes Visual Novel Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/bc428abf8563d1005f21a4d27c834cf74aecc435.jpg[/img]

🎉 It’s time to get dressed for Steam Visual Novel Fest! 🎉 

[b]KONOSUBA—God's Blessing on this Wonderful World! Love For These Clothes Of Desire![/b] Is so excited to be a part of Steam Visual Novel Fest this year that we have decided to share some super, top-secret, sneak-peak screenshots of the game, including features of:

[h1]📖 A new visual novel adventure! 
[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/f8ea00fa116578da44c2326fff0bd8cffc08df01.jpg[/img]

[h1]🔨 Choosing work for the gang! 
[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/0031e0e5638a394e2adc5afa182c7fa6373f6f25.jpg[/img]

[h1]🪵 Managing your resources! 
[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/314b4f4c3da697d944f781882c4a9966004d87a6.jpg[/img]

[h1]💡 Making the right choices! 
[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/a074b736c67ec6d0e178fbd47ae4655153f592b1.jpg[/img]
